requirements.focus: Combine software, collect and communicate data
Computing, digital media and IT capability

extensions.description: Virtual sensors, actuators, feedback, calibration and measurable missions. Physical hardware is optional.
Training/test separation, bias, uncertainty, provenance and responsible evaluation.
Threat modelling, permissions, validation, recovery and safe fixture-based security tests.
Specifications, version history, automated tests, reviews, architecture and maintenance.
Fixture-backed requests, response validation, errors and service boundaries.
Private evidence, iteration, accessibility, user feedback and reasoned evaluation.
